verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide data export or migration capability that lets a user take all their data out in open formats. The closest items do not qualify. Log Drains and audit-log draining to S3 or Splunk are log-retention routing, an adjacent feature. The REST API and SDK are developer building blocks. The Build Output API is a spec for deploying onto Vercel, not for leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
